WHO WE ARE

ABOUT MAPLE MOTORSPORTS

Founded in 2025 by veteran racer and entrepreneur Michael Maples, Maple Motorsports represents the culmination of decades of racing passion, military discipline, and business excellence. Based in Oklahoma, our team combines championship-level talent with cutting-edge technology and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

As a full-time competitor in the NASCAR ARCA Menards Series, Maple Motorsports is building a legacy of performance, integrity, and innovation. Our diverse roster of talented drivers brings together experience, youth, and determination, creating a dynamic team capable of competing at the highest levels of stock car racing.

From our state-of-the-art facilities to our experienced crew chiefs and mechanics, every aspect of Maple Motorsports is designed for one purpose: winning. We're not just racing – we're building a championship organization that will compete at NASCAR's highest levels for years to come.

Championship Focused

Every decision, every strategy, every race – focused on winning championships

Elite Talent

OUR DRIVERS

MEET THE TEAM

#99
OWNER / DRIVER
40+ Races Top 10s

MICHAEL MAPLES

Choctaw, Oklahoma 62 years old

Team Owner & Driver #99. Army veteran and oil industry entrepreneur. 7th place ARCA 2025, 8th place 2024. Founded Maple Motorsports after 30+ years racing experience. From California asphalt to ARCA championship contender.

Michael Maples is a 62-year-old racing veteran from Choctaw, Oklahoma. His passion for motorsports began in 1993 with asphalt late model racing in California. After a 21-year hiatus to focus on family, he returned to racing in 2019 with IMCA modifieds. In 2024, Michael made his dream a reality by entering the ARCA Menards Series with Fast Track Racing, finishing 8th in points. For 2025, Michael formed Maple Motorsports as both driver and owner of the #99 Chevrolet, finishing 7th in the championship. An Army veteran and oil industry entrepreneur, Michael brings discipline, experience, and championship ambition to every race.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

  • 2025: 7th Place ARCA Championship
  • 2024: 8th Place ARCA Championship
  • Maple Motorsports Founder & Owner
  • U.S. Army Veteran
  • Oil Industry Entrepreneur
  • 30+ Years Racing Experience
#91
DRIVER
2x Trailblazer International

RYAN VARGAS

La Mirada, California 25 years old

2x Wendell Scott Trailblazer Award winner and NASCAR Drive for Diversity graduate. International racing experience across Euro and Canada Series. Community champion and FACES board member inspiring young fans nationwide.

La Mirada, California's Ryan Vargas is more than just another young racer with a dream of making it to the top of NASCAR's ladder. Ryan started racing at 11 years old in 2012 and proved to be a quick learner, winning dozens of races and championships in lower divisions.

Now at 25 years old, Vargas has become a known name in the sport of NASCAR. In 2018, Ryan was signed onto the NASCAR Drive for Diversity Program and competed in the NASCAR K&N Pro Series East for Rev Racing. In 2019, Vargas made the jump to the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series and later the Craftsman Truck Series, garnering numerous top-20's and top-10's in his young NASCAR career.

Internationally, Vargas completed stints in the NASCAR Euro and NASCAR Canada Series, placing Top-10 in the standings in both series, securing overall Podiums and a Junior Class Victory in Germany (Sep. 2024).

Ryan's impressive 10-year racing career includes the 2016 and 2017 Wendell Scott Trailblazer Award which is the highest honors given to a minority (in Ryan's case, Hispanic) or female racer who competes in the NWAAS. Ryan is the first and only driver in NASCAR history to receive the prestigious award more than once.

Along with that, Vargas continues to use his diagnosis of Craniosynostosis (a skull deformation he had surgery for at 11 months old) to inspire young fans across the country to pursue their dreams no matter what.

In November of 2023, Ryan was named the 2023 Comcast Community Champion for his efforts as a board member of FACES: The National Craniofacial Association. As part of the award, FACES was given a donation of $60,000 to go towards grants for medical travel, events and the annual FACES Camp. In January 2024, Ryan was also recognized with the 2023 NMPA Q1 Pocono Spirit Award for his contributions with FACES.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

  • 2x Wendell Scott Trailblazer Award Winner (2016, 2017)
  • First Hispanic Driver to Win Award Twice
  • 2023 Comcast Community Champion
  • 2023 NMPA Q1 Pocono Spirit Award
  • FACES Association Board Member
  • NASCAR Drive for Diversity Graduate (2018)
  • NASCAR Euro & Canada Series Top-10
  • Germany Podium & Junior Class Victory (2024)
  • 10+ Year Racing Career
  • Craniosynostosis Awareness Advocate
SHANE
DRIVER
Navy Vet Boilermaker

SHANE BACKES

48 years old Racing since 1987

U.S. Navy EOD veteran, Union Boilermaker, and commercial diver. 35+ years racing from IHRA drag racing to NASCAR dirt series. Boilermakers Union partnership. Blue-collar excellence meets championship determination.

Shane Backes is a seasoned ARCA driver with an incredible life story that extends far beyond the racetrack. A proud U.S. Navy veteran who served as an EOD (Explosive Ordnance Disposal) specialist, Shane brings the same precision, courage, and dedication to racing that he demonstrated in service to his country. Currently a Union Boilermaker and commercial diver, Shane has been racing since he was 11 years old, competing in everything from IHRA Drag racing to NASCAR dirt series. His partnership with the Boilermakers Union showcases his commitment to working-class values and blue-collar excellence. Shane's decades of experience and unwavering work ethic make him a fierce competitor on any track.

#19
DRIVER
2025 ROOKIE OF THE YEAR
ROY 2025 4th Place

AUSTIN VAUGHN

Burnsville, Mississippi 17 years old

🏆 2025 ARCA East Rookie of the Year & 4th Place Championship finisher. From go-karts at 9 to ARCA at 15. Mississippi's youngest licensed stock car racer with pit crew experience and championship potential.

Seventeen-year-old Austin Vaughn from Burnsville, Mississippi has been chasing his dream of becoming a NASCAR driver since he was just three years old. His racing journey began in go-karts at age nine, where he developed a passion for speed and competition. By eleven, Austin had graduated to Open Wheel Modifieds, gaining valuable experience while racing against older, more seasoned competitors.

At fifteen, Austin made the jump to asphalt racing with no prior experience on the surface. During his very first test session, he impressed team officials enough to earn his ARCA license and begin his journey into NASCAR. That same year marked his ARCA Series debut at Du Quoin, Illinois in 2024, marking a major milestone and proving his ability to adapt quickly at a national level.

Also in 2024, Austin expanded his racing knowledge by working as part of an ARCA Series pit crew. The hands-on time on the pit box and in the garage gave him direct, real-world experience with pit stops, race strategy, and team communication, helping him better understand what it takes to succeed at a professional level, both on and off the track.

In 2025, Austin completed a full ARCA Menards East season along with select starts in the ARCA Menards Main Series. He finished fourth in the overall East driver standings and earned the NASCAR ARCA Menards East Rookie of the Year title.

Looking ahead to 2026, Austin's focus is on building another strong East season while gaining more experience in the Main Series as he continues his climb to the highest levels of professional racing.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

  • 🏆 2025 NASCAR ARCA Menards East ROOKIE OF THE YEAR
  • 4th Place - 2025 ARCA Menards East Championship
  • 2024 ARCA Series Debut at Du Quoin, Illinois
  • 2024 ARCA Series Pit Crew Experience
  • Full 2025 ARCA East Season + Main Series Starts
  • Started Racing at Age 9 (Go-Karts)
  • Open Wheel Modified Experience (Age 11)
  • Youngest Licensed Stock Car Racer in Mississippi
  • Career: Go-Karts → Open Wheel → ARCA (Age 15)

MONTY TIPTON

Mill Valley, California 18 years old

Eagle Scout, SF Symphony tuba player, and ARCA West competitor. Triple threat: academics, music, and racing. The future of NASCAR - intelligent, well-rounded, and fiercely competitive. Bare Bones sponsored.

At just 18 years old, Mill Valley native Monty Tipton has his bases covered. This remarkable young man is an Eagle Scout, plays tuba for the San Francisco Symphony Youth Orchestra, and is a competitive ARCA driver. Monty's unique background demonstrates the discipline, dedication, and multitasking abilities that translate directly to success on the racetrack. Competing part-time in the ARCA Menards Series West, Monty brings fresh talent and youthful energy to Maple Motorsports. His ability to balance academics, music, scouting, and professional racing at such a young age speaks volumes about his character and work ethic. Monty represents the future of NASCAR – intelligent, well-rounded, and fiercely competitive.
